description: #4549 — READ-command differential over `get_sync_relay_settings`, the same shape as `query_reminder_settings.json`: `seed.app_settings` puts the one `sync.internet_relay` row on both stacks and the read is on iff the stored value is the string `'1'`. Seeded ON, away from the default, so a mock answering a hard-coded default fails; the OFF reading is pinned by `sync_relay_settings_writes.json`, which switches it back off and re-reads. The answer is a bare struct with no id, so it projects to ONE token under the fixed head `sync_relay_settings`.
name: query_sync_relay_settings

queries.comment: Seeded `'1'`, so `enabled` is the boolean `true`. The default (`false`) fails.
queries.name: sync_relay_settings_seeded_on
